_what_this_is: A one-use maintainer decision. It states who permitted what, at what cumulative spend, against what cap, and what it does NOT authorize. It deliberately asserts no derived identity: the timestamp, the committed base, the harness digest, the session plan hash and the science plan hash are all computed by scripts/autoinit/issue_phase_a_authorization.py, which refuses a grant that claims any of them. Consumed by exactly one issuance; not reusable.
granted_by: Maintainer decision, 2026-08-18, following the accepted $0 fix at commit 4b7ee709d51d2d54ba45865c06545a6e77eba00e. Attempt 8 failed closed at the pod's blocking setup test gate on two assertions with invalid environment semantics, both introduced by the 2026-08-18 inventory and cleanup work and neither a real finding: a layout test that demanded every execution environment be the maintainer host, and a tombstone naming a routine session staging destination. Both are now closed at the correct semantic level - the external storage paths are kept and the layout test is host-aware on the existing out-of-tree-registry precedent, stage3_ladder_uniform_local_cache is withdrawn with its deletion and hashes preserved, and one declaration-driven regression forbids an active tombstone naming any declared staging or mirror destination. The maintainer records that Stages 0-5 have not yet run under the exact current harness, and rules that this is the uncertainty Phase A itself exercises rather than a reason for a further pre-run surrogate. No canary, readiness phase, harness layer or maintenance task is to be added before this launch.
covers: One (1) launch of AutoInitializer Phase A, attempt 9, on a single NVIDIA L40S at no more than $0.99/h, proceeding through the frozen Stage 0-5 protocol without any new scientific or infrastructure change, under the existing watchdog, soft-stop, hard-stop, artifact-gate and provider-confirmed teardown behaviour. Authorized pricing: expected $17.8933, soft stop $22.7183, priced hard value $23.0483, per-launch hard ceiling $23.0484.
does_not_authorize: Attempt 10, or any retry after a failure - a failed pre-provider, setup, Stage-0, Stage-1, pricing, authorization, bundle-identity, artifact or provider gate is a fail-closed stop for review, never a repair on the live pod. Reviving the device canary, which remains strategically terminated. Any other paid session, generation run, evaluation run or storage operation. Any change to the frozen science: science plan 02be33b9, session plan 9377a2dc, Stage-3 protocol 250f72ef, equivalence interval 0.011695296982299022, feasibility floor 0.3, the sa/sb and conditional sc seed policy, the search, recovery and selection rules, or the permanent controls and frozen checkpoints. Any further readiness or maintenance work before the run. Treating the $24.7570 of unused cumulative headroom as authorization beyond this one launch.
fail_closed_instruction: On any failed gate: do not repair around it on the live pod. Record the evidence, terminate with provider confirmation, and stop for review.
on_completion: If the run succeeds, continue through the frozen Phase-A protocol and report the scientific result. If it fails, preserve the evidence and stop. Either way report commits and hashes, authorization identity, bundle round-trip, provider/pod lifecycle, stage-by-stage result, actual spend, collected artifacts and teardown confirmation. Do not independently authorize a subsequent attempt.
